patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Lusha's shape. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Demandbase's shape. Workflow advantage: Demandbase leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Lusha leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging.; Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences..
- Workflow coverage skew: Demandbase-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Lusha-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene..

Limitations — Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost; Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over..

Poor-fit cases: Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Avoid Demandbase if you actually need Lusha's motion (B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, si)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
